lines.text: Three days after arriving, Festus goes up to Jerusalem, where the chief priests and Jewish leaders ask him to summon Paul.
Festus refuses and tells the leaders to come down and accuse Paul in Caesarea, where he goes after eight or ten days.
The next day Festus sits on the judgment seat, and the Jews from Jerusalem surround Paul with charges they can prove.

wrong_details.true: charges that they could not prove

lines.text: Paul says he has committed no offense, and when Festus asks about trial in Jerusalem, Paul says he ought to be tried before the council.

wrong_details.true: tried before the judgment seat of Caesar

lines.text: Paul appeals to Caesar, and after conferring with his council, Festus replies that to Caesar he will go.
